india_invested.summary:
* **CYIENTDLM** - Smartkarma highlighted strong Q1 FY27 growth (Revenue +34%, EBITDA +56%, PAT +118% YoY) and its Build-To-Spec pivot; virtual investor meeting with Citi scheduled for September 15, 2026.
* **INTERARCH** - Secured an ₹83 crore order for an energy transmission project.
* **LAURUSLABS** - Stock hit an all-time high of ₹1,980.65 as market capitalization crossed ₹1 lakh crore.
* **QPOWER** - MarketsMojo upgraded the stock rating to "Buy" on September 11, 2026.
* **SAKAR** - Stock rose approximately 3.70% to 3.96% on September 11, 2026, closing near ₹1,161.50.
* **SANSERA** - Scheduled a Jefferies group meeting in Bangalore on September 15, 2026.
* **SHILPAMED** - Received final CDSCO Subject Expert Committee approval for marketing authorization of OERIS™ (Ondansetron Extended-Release Injection, 100 mg/mL) in India.
* **VENUSPIPES** - Scheduled an announcement regarding CMD re-appointment for September 14, 2026, and a September 16 board meeting to consider fundraising via preferential issue or private placement.
* **STLTECH** - Shares in focus following US certification for AI data center fiber assemblies.
* **UFBL** - Issued a ₹17 crore SBLC for subsidiary Barbeque Nation Restaurant LLC's loan; stock fell 4.61% to close at ₹704.00.

us_invested.summary:
* **HIMS (HIMS)** - JP Morgan reinstated coverage with a Neutral rating and a $32 price target.
* **IAU (IAU)** - Analysts report weak near- and mid-term sentiment for the trust.
* **J&J (JNJ)** - Apollo is in advanced talks to acquire its DePuy Synthes unit for ~$20 billion, Jaguar LAA agreed to acquire its Laminar assets, new RYBREVANT data was presented at WCLC, Rinkey cut its stake by 84%, and management has upcoming presentations on September 14-15.
* **KRYS (KRYS)** - California State Teachers Retirement System significantly increased its position in the company.
* **Meta (META)** - CPO Christopher Cox sold $13 million in stock, Mitsubishi UFJ raised its stake by 8.5%, and analysts highlighted the revenue potential of the new Muse AI agent.
* **Natera (NTRA)** - Executive Chairman Matthew Rabinowitz sold ~$16.4 million in shares under a 10b5-1 plan on September 11, while Engineers Gate Manager raised its stake by 43.6% in Q2.
* **ORCL (ORCL)** - Reported Q1 FY27 revenue of $19.3 billion and $1.92 adjusted EPS, added $700 million to its 2026 restructuring plan ($2.8 billion total), and received a price target downgrade to $165 at RBC.
* **RKLB (RKLB)** - Shares rose ~4% to ~$64.22 following its 16th successful Electron launch of the year, and Raymond James initiated coverage with an Outperform rating and $80 price target.
* **TWST (TWST)** - Reported 23% YoY Q3 2026 revenue growth, ARK ETF sold 46,015 shares, and management will participate in a fireside chat at the Baird conference on September 15.
* **Zscaler (ZS)** - Wedbush reiterated an Outperform rating with a $215 price target, and California State Teachers Retirement System significantly increased its Q2 holdings.
* **ASX (ASX)** - Reported strong August revenue of NT$82.25 billion on September 11 and is scheduled to attend the UBS Taiwan Summit on September 15.
* **AMKR (AMKR)** - Disclosed a new $2.99 million position from Virginia Retirement Systems on September 11 alongside a Moderate Buy consensus recommendation from 12 brokerages.
* **ARM (ARM)** - Piper Sandler upgraded the stock to Strong-Buy on September 11 as the company announced a major new product lineup including Arm CSS for Mobile 2.
* **Alpha Cognition (ACOG)** - Opaleye Management disclosed a $20.91 million stake in the company, representing an approximate 13.3% ownership position.
* **CLS (CLS)** - Shares rose ~6% following the announcement of a leadership restructure naming Mandeep Chawla as Group President of Global Markets and Todd Ankenmann as CFO, effective October 1, 2026.
